page.title: thatは、選ばずスムーズにつなぐ

analysis.summaryJa: 関係代名詞thatが人・物・複合先行詞を受け、only・序数・最上級・all系で自然になる仕組みと、目的格の省略を問う。
grammarPoints: thatは人と物の両方を受けられる。
only・序数・最上級・all系の後ではthatが自然。
目的格thatは省略可、主格thatは省略不可。
カンマ付き非制限用法ではthatを使わない。
visualEvidence: 人と物が同じTHATトンネルを通る図。
commonTraps: 複合先行詞をwho/whichだけで受ける。

questions.prompt: The first training module ------- new employees complete covers data security.

choices.A: who
choices.B: where
choices.D: what

questions.translationJa: 新入社員が最初に修了する研修モジュールは、データセキュリティを扱います。
questions.explanationJa: 先行詞がthe first moduleで、後続節completeの目的語が欠けています。

questions.prompt: Everything ------- was left in the meeting room has been moved to reception.

choices.A: that
choices.B: who
choices.D: what

questions.translationJa: 会議室に残されていたものはすべて受付へ移されました。
questions.explanationJa: everythingを受け、後続節was leftの主語になる関係代名詞thatが必要です。

questions.prompt: The representatives and product samples ------- arrived this morning are ready for the exhibition.

choices.A: who
choices.B: which
choices.D: that

questions.translationJa: 今朝到着した担当者と製品サンプルは展示会の準備ができています。
questions.explanationJa: 人representativesと物product samplesをまとめて受けるため、両方に使えるthatが最適です。
questions.focus: 人と物をまとめて受けるthat

questions.prompt: This is the only entrance ------- remains open after 8 p.m.

choices.A: who
choices.B: that
choices.D: what

questions.translationJa: ここが午後8時以降も開いている唯一の入口です。
questions.explanationJa: the onlyで限定されたentranceを修飾し、remainsの主語になるthatを使います。

questions.prompt: The most useful advice ------- I received during orientation concerned customer privacy.

choices.A: that
choices.B: who
choices.D: why

questions.translationJa: オリエンテーション中に私が受けた最も役立つ助言は、顧客のプライバシーに関するものでした。
questions.explanationJa: 最上級the most usefulを含む先行詞ではthatが自然です。

questions.prompt: All ------- the auditor requested was a copy of the signed contract.

choices.A: who
choices.B: which
choices.D: where

questions.translationJa: 監査担当者が求めたのは、署名済み契約書の写しだけでした。
questions.explanationJa: allを先行詞として『要求したすべて』を表す定型的なall that節です。

questions.prompt: The last vendor ------- submitted a complete proposal will be contacted tomorrow.

choices.A: which
choices.B: that
choices.D: where

questions.translationJa: 完全な提案書を最後に提出した業者には明日連絡します。
questions.explanationJa: the last vendorを受け、submittedの主語になるthatが必要です。

questions.prompt: Is there anything ------- needs to be updated before the website launch?

choices.A: who
choices.B: when
choices.D: that

questions.translationJa: ウェブサイト公開前に更新する必要があるものは何かありますか。
questions.explanationJa: anythingを受け、needsの主語になる関係代名詞thatを置きます。

questions.prompt: The director selected the candidate and proposal ------- best matched the client's priorities.

choices.A: who
choices.B: which
choices.D: whom

questions.translationJa: 部長は、顧客の優先事項に最も合った候補者と提案書を選びました。
questions.explanationJa: 人candidateと物proposalの複合先行詞を同時に受け、matchedの主語になるthatが唯一適切です。

questions.prompt: Every component ------- was installed during the upgrade is covered by the warranty.

choices.A: that
choices.B: who
choices.D: whose

questions.translationJa: 更新作業中に取り付けられたすべての部品は保証対象です。
questions.explanationJa: everyを伴うcomponentを受け、was installedの主語になるthatを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about offline access.

choices.A: The only application who works offline is the inventory tool.
choices.B: The only application that works offline is the inventory tool.
choices.C: The only application works offline is the inventory tool.
choices.D: The only application that it works offline is the inventory tool.

questions.translationJa: オフラインで動作する唯一のアプリケーションは在庫管理ツールです。
questions.explanationJa: thatがapplicationを受けてworksの主語になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a room reservation.

choices.A: The conference room we reserved it has a video screen.
choices.B: The conference room reserved we has a video screen.
choices.C: The conference room who we reserved has a video screen.
choices.D: The conference room we reserved has a video screen.

questions.translationJa: 私たちが予約した会議室にはビデオスクリーンがあります。
questions.explanationJa: we reservedの目的語に当たる関係代名詞thatは省略できます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an inspection.

choices.A: The technicians and devices that passed inspection will be assigned to the project.
choices.B: The technicians and devices who passed inspection will be assigned to the project.
choices.C: The technicians and devices which it passed inspection will be assigned to the project.
choices.D: The technicians and devices passed inspection will be assigned to the project.

questions.translationJa: 検査に合格した技術者と機器がそのプロジェクトに割り当てられます。
questions.explanationJa: 人と物をまとめた先行詞にはthatを使い、that自身がpassedの主語になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about confidential information.

choices.A: Everything who was discussed in the interview remains confidential.
choices.B: Everything that it was discussed in the interview remains confidential.
choices.C: Everything that was discussed in the interview remains confidential.
choices.D: Everything was discussed in the interview remains confidential.

questions.translationJa: 面接で話し合われたことはすべて機密扱いのままです。
questions.explanationJa: everythingを受ける主格thatが必要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a customer inquiry.

choices.A: The first customer which contacted the help desk received a priority response.
choices.B: The first customer that contacted the help desk received a priority response.
choices.C: The first customer that the customer contacted the help desk received a priority response.
choices.D: The first customer contacted the help desk received a priority response.

questions.translationJa: ヘルプデスクへ最初に連絡した顧客には優先対応が行われました。
questions.explanationJa: the first customerを受け、contactedの主語になるthatが正しいです。
questions.focus: 序数を含む先行詞と主格that

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about recommended equipment.

choices.A: The equipment the supplier recommended arrived ahead of schedule.
choices.B: The equipment the supplier recommended it arrived ahead of schedule.
choices.C: The equipment who the supplier recommended arrived ahead of schedule.
choices.D: The equipment the supplier was recommended arrived ahead of schedule.

questions.translationJa: 仕入先が推奨した機器は予定より早く到着しました。
questions.explanationJa: recommendedの目的語に当たるthatは省略できます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a proposed solution.

choices.A: The best option who we have identified requires no additional hardware.
choices.B: The best option that we have identified it requires no additional hardware.
choices.C: The best option we have identify requires no additional hardware.
choices.D: The best option that we have identified requires no additional hardware.

questions.translationJa: 私たちが特定した最良の選択肢には追加のハードウェアが不要です。
questions.explanationJa: 最上級bestを含む先行詞にthatが自然で、thatはidentifiedの目的語です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a parcel.

choices.A: The parcel arrived yesterday was addressed to the finance department.
choices.B: The parcel that it arrived yesterday was addressed to the finance department.
choices.C: The parcel that arrived yesterday was addressed to the finance department.
choices.D: The parcel whom arrived yesterday was addressed to the finance department.

questions.translationJa: 昨日到着した小包は財務部宛てでした。
questions.explanationJa: thatはarrivedの主語なので省略できません。
questions.focus: 主格関係代名詞の必須性

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence containing an added comment.

choices.A: Mr. Imai, that leads the audit team, will join the call at three.
choices.B: Mr. Imai, who leads the audit team, will join the call at three.
choices.C: Mr. Imai that leads the audit team, will join the call at three.
choices.D: Mr. Imai, who he leads the audit team, will join the call at three.

questions.translationJa: 監査チームを率いる今井さんは、3時の電話会議に参加します。
questions.explanationJa: カンマ付きの補足説明ではthatを使わずwhoを使います。
questions.focus: カンマ付き節ではthat不可

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the remaining work.

choices.A: All who remains is to obtain the client's signature.
choices.B: All that it remains is to obtain the client's signature.
choices.C: All remains that is to obtain the client's signature.
choices.D: All that remains is to obtain the client's signature.

questions.translationJa: 残っているのは顧客の署名を得ることだけです。
questions.explanationJa: all that remainsで『残っているすべて＝あとは～だけ』を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The first workshop that I attended focused on negotiation.”

choices.A: I attended the workshop only after the negotiation ended.
choices.B: The first workshop was attended by everyone except me.
choices.C: Negotiation was discussed before I attended any workshop.
choices.D: The first workshop I attended focused on negotiation.

questions.translationJa: 私が最初に参加した研修は交渉を扱っていました。
questions.explanationJa: 元文のthatはattendedの目的語なので省略できます。
questions.focus: 目的格thatの省略による言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Everything that the customer ordered has been shipped.”

choices.A: The customer shipped every item personally.
choices.B: All the items the customer ordered have been shipped.
choices.C: Some of the customer's ordered items are still waiting.
choices.D: Everything was shipped before the customer placed the order.

questions.translationJa: 顧客が注文した品物はすべて発送済みです。
questions.explanationJa: everything that the customer orderedをall the items the customer orderedと言い換えています。
questions.focus: everything thatとall the itemsの対応

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The supervisor and checklist that guided us were both helpful.”

choices.A: Only the supervisor, not the checklist, guided us.
choices.B: The checklist was helpful, but the supervisor was absent.
choices.C: Both the supervisor and the checklist helped guide us.
choices.D: Neither the supervisor nor the checklist gave us guidance.

questions.translationJa: 監督者とチェックリストの両方が、私たちを導くのに役立ちました。
questions.explanationJa: 元文ではthatが人と物の両方を受けています。
questions.focus: 人＋物を受けるthat節の言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The only route that remains open passes through the east gate.”

choices.A: No route except the one through the east gate remains open.
choices.B: Every open route avoids the east gate.
choices.C: The east gate is closed, but all other routes are open.
choices.D: More than one route remains open through different gates.

questions.translationJa: 東門を通るルート以外は開いていません。
questions.explanationJa: the only routeをno route except the oneと言い換え、開いているルートが一つだけという意味を保っています。
questions.focus: the onlyの排他的言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The lowest price that the supplier offered was $8,400.”

choices.A: The supplier did not provide a price of $8,400.
choices.B: Every price from the supplier was below $8,400.
choices.D: No price the supplier offered was lower than $8,400.

questions.translationJa: その仕入先が提示した価格の中で、8,400ドルより低いものはありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 最上級the lowestをno ... lower thanで表し直しています。
questions.focus: 最上級と比較表現の言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The last employee that left the office locked the door.”

choices.A: The door was locked before any employee left.
choices.B: Every employee locked a different office door.
choices.C: The employee who left after everyone else locked the door.
choices.D: The first employee to leave forgot to lock the door.

questions.translationJa: ほかの全員より後に退社した従業員がドアを施錠しました。
questions.explanationJa: the last employee that leftは『最後に出た従業員』なので、who left after everyone elseと同じ意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “All that we need is written approval.”

choices.A: We need nothing except written approval.
choices.B: Written approval is the only thing we do not need.
choices.C: We need approval in writing as well as several other items.
choices.D: Nothing can be approved in writing.

questions.translationJa: 必要なのは書面による承認だけです。
questions.explanationJa: all that we needは『必要なものすべて』ですが、補語が一つなのでnothing exceptで『それだけ』と同義になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Anything that arrives after noon will be processed tomorrow.”

choices.A: Only items arriving before noon will be processed tomorrow.
choices.B: Any item arriving after noon will be processed tomorrow.
choices.C: All items will be processed today regardless of arrival time.
choices.D: Nothing that arrives after noon can ever be processed.

questions.translationJa: 正午以降に到着する品物はどれでも明日処理されます。
questions.explanationJa: anything that arrivesをany item arrivingと言い換えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The staff and equipment that are ready will move first.”

choices.A: Only the equipment will move before the staff is ready.
choices.B: All staff and equipment will move, whether ready or not.
choices.C: The staff will prepare the equipment after everyone moves.
choices.D: Both the ready staff and the ready equipment will move first.

questions.translationJa: 準備のできたスタッフと機器の両方が最初に移動します。
questions.explanationJa: thatは人staffと物equipmentの両方を修飾しています。
questions.focus: 複合先行詞の修飾範囲

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The documents that I sent yesterday need one correction.”

choices.A: I corrected the documents before sending them yesterday.
choices.B: The documents need to be sent, but I did not send them yesterday.
choices.C: The documents I sent yesterday need one correction.
choices.D: Only one of yesterday's documents was sent.

questions.translationJa: 私が昨日送った書類には1か所修正が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: thatはsentの目的語なので省略できます。

questions.prompt: I have attached the only draft ------- includes the revised delivery schedule. Please review page three before noon.

choices.A: that
choices.B: who
choices.D: what

questions.translationJa: 改訂された配送予定を含む唯一の草案を添付しました。正午までに3ページを確認してください。
questions.explanationJa: the only draftを受け、includesの主語になるthatが必要です。

questions.prompt: The receiving team has finished today's count. Everything ------- arrived before 10 a.m. is already in the system.

choices.A: who
choices.B: where
choices.D: whose

questions.translationJa: 受入チームは本日の集計を終えました。午前10時前に到着したものはすべて、すでにシステムへ登録されています。
questions.explanationJa: everythingを受け、arrivedの主語になるthatを使います。

questions.prompt: Our agency confirmed the hotel and shuttle ------- the conference organizers selected. Both reservations are listed below.

choices.A: who
choices.B: that
choices.D: when

questions.translationJa: 当社は会議主催者が選んだホテルと送迎車を確認しました。両方の予約を以下に記載しています。
questions.explanationJa: 物を二つまとめて受け、selectedの目的語になるthatが適切です。
questions.focus: 複数の物を受ける目的格that

questions.prompt: The agenda contains six topics. The first issue ------- we should address is the shortage of storage space.

choices.A: who
choices.B: where
choices.D: that

questions.translationJa: 議題には6つの項目があります。最初に取り上げるべき問題は保管場所の不足です。
questions.explanationJa: the first issueを修飾し、addressの目的語になるthatを使います。

questions.prompt: The caller did not request a refund. All ------- she wanted was a replacement cable.

choices.A: who
choices.B: which
choices.D: where

questions.translationJa: 電話の相手は返金を求めませんでした。彼女が望んだのは交換用ケーブルだけでした。
questions.explanationJa: all that she wantedで『彼女が望んだすべて＝望んだのは～だけ』を表します。

questions.prompt: One shipment is still missing from the report. The last package ------- was scanned came from Northline Logistics.

choices.A: who
choices.B: where
choices.D: that

questions.translationJa: 報告書にはまだ1件の出荷がありません。最後にスキャンされた小包はNorthline Logisticsからのものでした。
questions.explanationJa: the last packageを受け、was scannedの主語になるthatが必要です。

questions.prompt: We reviewed every applicant's materials. The candidate and portfolio ------- impressed the panel most are highlighted in yellow.

choices.A: that
choices.B: who
choices.D: whom

questions.translationJa: 全応募者の資料を確認しました。審査員に最も強い印象を与えた候補者と作品集を黄色で示しています。
questions.explanationJa: 人candidateと物portfolioをまとめて受け、impressedの主語になるthatが最適です。

questions.prompt: Safety orientation begins at nine. The most important rule ------- new staff learn is to report damaged equipment immediately.

choices.A: who
choices.B: that
choices.D: why

questions.translationJa: 安全オリエンテーションは9時に始まります。新入社員が学ぶ最も重要な規則は、破損した機器を直ちに報告することです。
questions.explanationJa: 最上級the most importantを含む先行詞にthatが自然で、learnの目的語になっています。

questions.prompt: The accounting software ------- we installed last month can now generate bilingual invoices. A short guide is attached.

choices.A: that
choices.B: who
choices.D: whose

questions.translationJa: 先月導入した会計ソフトは、現在、二言語の請求書を作成できます。簡単なガイドを添付しています。
questions.explanationJa: softwareを受け、installedの目的語になるthatが正解です。

questions.prompt: Please use the workstation near the window. It is the only desk ------- has both a power outlet and a network port.

choices.A: who
choices.B: that
choices.D: whom

questions.translationJa: 窓の近くの作業台を使ってください。電源コンセントとネットワーク端子の両方がある唯一の机です。
questions.explanationJa: the only deskを受け、hasの主語になるthatが必要です。
